Service worker blocker probe

Running…

Targetpageworkerproxied

What to check

  1. control must say reached in all three columns. In worker or proxied it says whether this site's service workers have the network at all.
  2. beacon, collect and matomo are EasyPrivacy rules on this very host. The page column must say blocked (content blocker on, EasyPrivacy enabled). With Settings → Developer → Experimental → Service workers through blockers off, worker and proxied say reached; switch it on, restart the app (it is read at launch) and they must say blocked too.
  3. The three DNS rows go to tracker hosts every DNS level names, one host per column, so they cannot be seen from here. Tap the site's block banner: with the switch on, the hosts blocked most include all three; with it off, only the page's (pagead2.googlesyndication.com), and the other two requests went out.
  4. App logs, on every attach of this site's webview: with the switch off, ServiceWorker: site=… network blocked=… (experiment off); with it on, ServiceWorker: site=… through the site's blockers (network blocked was …). No such line means the site has no container of its own, where the switch does nothing.
